task_specification.objective: Repair the native authored cemetery integration so ordinary traversal has readable landmark exposure, aligned collision, sufficient traversable scale, coherent external depth, and stable perimeter containment while preserving the Godot baselines and existing choice UI hierarchy.

diagnosis.root_cause: The shipped camera integration still exposes a gameplay-layer GroundCollision occluder and only partial Warden/CemeteryGarden coverage, while prior camera/transform tuning did not make the native authored package and gameplay datum share a stable visibility contract.

stop_conditions: Do not replace, split, hide, delete, or surgically edit the preserved authored cemetery package.
Do not schedule deferred ordinary-wave-route verification, dense profiling, or unrelated asset-family expansion.
Do not add proxy roads, floor patches, facade slices, duplicate map instances, or a second visual environment.
Stop after the focused world repair is implemented and host recapture can directly retest the active issue.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy from repeated camera transform tuning: audit every shipped scene binding, explicitly isolate GroundCollision and other gameplay-only bodies from camera visibility queries, and rebase the single intact authored package plus its anchors, navigation, collision, and perimeter into one transform-space contract. Compare direct instance restoration, wrapper/binding repair, replacement, and explicit isolation first; choose isolation plus binding repair unless fresh evidence proves package-level incompatibility.

code: Run the candidate's existing project/resource validation and confirm validate:native_godot_project and validate:host_godot_boot remain passing.
Check that the diff preserves a single authored environment instance, does not mutate imported source assets, and introduces no proxy floor/road/backdrop or duplicate landmark package.
runtime: Host recaptures the failed spatial cells using the shipped camera: spawn, mid-route, central landmark approach/near contact/departure, and perimeter/cardinal views.

Host replays ordinary movement around every side of the central landmark and along the full boundary, collecting runtime state/scene3d evidence for shared transform space, collision alignment, navigation reachability, perimeter containment, and absence of pass-through or disappearance.
Host verifies GroundCollision is excluded from camera sightline occlusion while landmark collision remains authoritative for player/enemy movement; Tester owns the formal issue verdict and closure.
visual: Inspect the same-framing gameplay screenshots for larger traversable scale, coherent external world/external depth, exposed Warden and central building/landmarks, readable escape lanes, and no abrupt empty edge or occlusion drift.

Smoke-test the weapon/upgrade choice state at the native viewport with keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus paths, confirming the authored silhouette/stat hierarchy remains readable and unchanged-row filtering is intact.

done_when: The native authored cemetery package remains one intact authoritative instance, while the gameplay arena has a larger traversable scale and a coherent external world with external depth beyond the playable perimeter.

The central building and every required landmark, including the Warden approach view, remain readable from spawn, critical route, near-contact, departure, and cardinal gameplay views; there is no whole-landmark disappearance or camera occlusion drift.
GroundCollision and other gameplay-only bodies cannot register as camera sightline occluders, while authored landmark collision remains aligned to visible geometry and blocks pass-through correctly.

The playable boundary/perimeter contains ordinary movement and enemy approach without void exposure, invisible barriers, or leaving the authored datum; navigation, spawn, objective, and camera anchors all use the same native streets/terrain space.

Tester can run an ordinary movement replay around every side of the central landmark and along the full boundary, confirming stable visibility, collision, no disappearance, no pass-through, and no abrupt external-edge void.

Weapon and upgrade choices retain an authored visual hierarchy with recognizable silhouettes/icons, truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas, no placeholder CURRENT values or unchanged rows, restrained copy, and complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states.
tasks.instructions: Own the active arena exposure/readability issue at the world integration boundary. Inspect the current authored scene instance, survival scene bindings, camera coverage/occlusion code, and spatial contract. Determine whether the shipped failure is caused by a stale instance/wrapper transform, mismatched anchor space, camera query mask, or gameplay-only collision being treated as a sightline blocker. Implement the smallest coherent repair: keep the intact authored cemetery package and native streets, rebase the package/wrapper and gameplay anchors into one datum, isolate GroundCollision from camera visibility without weakening movement collision, and align landmark/perimeter bodies, navigation, spawn, objective, and camera framing. Preserve the current HUD/choice implementation; only touch its directly related files if needed to prevent a regression against the stated choice-hierarchy acceptance. Do not replace the environment package or introduce proxy geometry. Make the repair directly retestable by shipped-camera coverage and ordinary movement replay.
